messages:
jess_ops: Quick FYI — planned release tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC for inference-service v2.3.5. Expect a light traffic bump (~10%). Please sign up for watchers if you're available. Freeze window: 22:45-00:45 UTC (no infra changes). I'll be handing oncall at 22:30.

ryan_sre: Noted. I'll be primary watcher from 22:30-01:00. @ben_p can you take secondary?

ben_p: Can do 22:45-00:30. Will keep pager on. What's the canary %?

jess_ops: Canary plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 15m, then 100% on success. Rollback on error-rate > 3% or p95 latency increase > 200ms. Watchers: +metrics, +logs, +traces.

sara_eng: Heads-up: this deploy includes switching the model to a 4-bit quantized variant to reduce token costs. We've seen sporadic OOMs on A100s at large batch sizes in staging. Mitigations: set MAX_BATCH=32 and fallback to fp16 variant on OOM. Config snippet for the canary: 

```
canary:
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 900
      env:
        MODEL_VARIANT: quantized_4bit
        MAX_BATCH: 32
    - pct: 25
      duration: 900
```

ryan_sre: Good catch. Add an automatic fallback rule to route to fp16 if inference returns 502/503 for >1% of requests in a 60s window. Also monitor GPU eviction events.

jess_ops: Done — added to rollout policy. deploy-bot will publish the final plan and URL.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: inference-service v2.3.5 -> starts 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z. Canary watchers: ryan_sre, ben_p, sara_eng. See /deploys/1773 for logs.

ben_p: I'll monitor GPU mem and eviction events (dashboard: /dash/gpu-metrics). I'll set alerts: page at >85% GPU mem or >5 evictions/min.

oncall-bot: Note: jess_ops will be off-call from 00:45-08:00 UTC. Paging rotations unchanged. Reaction :white_check_mark:.

ryan_sre: Quick question — any DB migrations in this release? If so we need a migration window.

sara_eng: No DB migrations, only model variant swap and config tweak. No schema changes.

jess_ops: If anything goes wrong, rollback is immediate to the previous image and pin model to fp16. Ping this thread and @ryan_sre to kick rollback. I'll be on Slack until 01:00.

ben_p: Acknowledged. I'll be in watch channel #deploy-watchers and set my status.

sara_eng: Added a short smoke test you can run for canary verification:

```
curl -X POST https://inference.test/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"lorem ipsum","max_tokens":16}'
```

ryan_sre: Thanks — all set. Good luck everyone.
